text: Hello boys and girls, welcome to Daisy's class.Today we will go on reviewing listening, and we'll talk about how to obtain information as required in listening.During the lesson, you will get to know different types of information, and how to obtain the information from different listening materials.At the same time, you will get the chance to review how predicting works in listening activities.And with the help of the strategy, the efficiency of getting information will be improved.Please get your pen and the worksheet ready.Let's get started.In listening, we are often required to obtain information from different listening materials, such as sentences, short or long conversations, and passages, mainly stories or informational texts.In listening, we often obtain information about time, numbers, persons, things, and so on.We are often asked to listen to the sentences and choose the right picture.Normally, information in pictures is about items or persons, as you can see in the following pictures.To pick out the right picture from similar ones while listening to the sentences, we should make predictions before listening.Read the pictures carefully, think about what we are going to hear in the sentences, and meanwhile figure out the differences.Let's get some practice.Please look at task one on your worksheet.Listen to the sentence and choose the right picture.You'll hear three short sentences only once.Alright, let's see what information you can get from each picture.The first pair, picture A.What are the people doing?Yes, camping.Picture B, good, they are having a picnic.So picture B is the right one.The second pair.In picture A, the girl is lying on the beach.While in picture B, they are playing volleyball on the beach.So this time picture A is the right one.Last pair.Picture A, children are reading books.While in picture B, a lady is telling stories to children.While listening to conversations, we obtain a wide variety of information, such as the weather, the time, the way of traveling, the way things are done, the location of a place or a thing, people's preferences, reasons, and so on.To answer the question while listening to a conversation, we should focus on the relevant information according to the question.For example, we want to find out which subject Matt likes.We need to focus on the words related to subjects.Got it?Please move on to task two.Let's see how it works through practice.This time you'll hear five short conversations only once.I'm thinking about wearing my new dress tomorrow.It's beautiful.But you know it's going to be cold and rainy tomorrow, don't you?Oh no, it has been raining for days.How are we going to get home?It's so late that the buses and the undergrounds all stopped running.Then we have to call a taxi home.Alright.Have you got any plan for this weekend, Jerry?What's up, Elle?I planned to watch a football match with Daphne, but she told me to attend a meeting.Since you are free, take the tickets to watch the match with your friend.Wonderful.Thank you so much.I will ask Simon to go with me.Hi, David.Have you found your key yet?You know, I looked for it almost everywhere in the classroom and the reading room, but failed.Just when I wanted to give up, I suddenly realized it was in the pocket of my trousers.I'd like to buy a new iPhone.Do you have a pink one?Sorry, we don't have that color, but we have golden and silver ones.Okay, I will take a silver one.You can get the information directly from the conversation.Let's check one by one.The weather will be very good.Cold and rainy tomorrow.Because the buses and the undergrounds all stopped running, they had to call a taxi home.Number three.The conversation is a bit longer, but not complicated.In it, the boy said, I'll ask Simon to go with me.So, Jerry will go to watch the match with Simon.Please pay attention to the spelling of the name.Let's move on to number four.David tried hard to look for his key.Finally, where did he find it?In the potter?Um, no.Should be in the pocket of his trousers.Last one.What color?You are not sure?It's okay.The woman said, I'll take a silver one.Silver is the color she will choose for new mobile phone.To make sure we get the right information, we should pay attention to word linking.For example, just now you heard, in the pocket of his trousers, people usually join the sound together with the off to read as tuff.Let's try.In the pocket of his trousers.And, we should pay attention to the correct pronunciation of the word as well.Just now, some of you failed to get silver and got confused with safer.Sometimes, we are asked to choose the best answer while listening to a conversation.To make the right choice, we should always read the choices carefully and make predictions.And, we should sometimes understand the way the facts are presented.Let's get some practice to see how it works.Please look at task three.Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer to the question.You will hear four short conversations once.Take notes if necessary.Excuse me, I want to complain about this juice.What's the problem?When I opened the bottle, I found the juice was a funny color.I'm so sorry about that.I'll take care of it now.Nice to have you back, Jack.Did you have a good summer?I delivered flowers for a flower shop and made some money.What about you, Judy?I went to the mountains with my family.Did you have a good time?Oh, wonderful.I went swimming every day.That sounds great.How do you keep in touch with your parents, Jason?By WeChat, sending woman complained about the juice because she found the juice was a funny color.But you can't find exactly the same phrase in the choices.Which one is the closest to the fact?Yes, D, because she thought the juice went bad.Two, you can get what Jack did during the summer.He delivered flowers from flower shop and made some money.But you can't find any choice stating the fact exactly the same as
